name: MediPhi
context_scaling: Inherited unchanged from microsoft/Phi-3.5-mini-instruct (config.json max_position_embeddings 131072). This derivative does not publish a context-extension recipe of its own.
notes: ADDED 2026-10-26. A merge of microsoft/Phi-3.5-mini-instruct, not a new base model: same config.json, same 3.821 parameters (identical tensor set). Recorded as a contender because it publishes benchmark evidence against its own base; the evidence rows below are card-sourced and marked vendor_claim. Licence mit, repo created 2025-02-03. CAVEATS: CLUE+ is Microsoft's own extension of CLUE (12 tasks, authored in the same paper), so the benchmark is the vendor's. MediPhi is a BreadCrumbs merge of five domain experts back into Phi-3.5-mini, not an SFT; it loses PLS (28.8 vs 28.4 is a win, but LH 45.7 vs 45.9 and MeDiSumCode 41.7 vs 41.1 are margin-level) and is beaten by its own MediPhi-Instruct sibling on the average (43.4 vs 39.3). Card prints no shot count or harness.
